headline: Reference databases add programmatic access, versioned releases and expanded annotation coverage
label: Biological Reference Databases And Interfaces
summary: Database updates from NCBI, RGD, DGIdb and IGVF emphasize APIs, versioned data and integrated annotation for genome-function and drug-gene resources.
synthesis: The items are maintained reference resources for sequence, domain, disease-model, drug-gene and functional-genomics data. The common thread is a move toward interoperable, programmatically accessible infrastructure. DGIdb 2026 adds new sources, Python/R client libraries, Docker images and versioned releases. NCBI's 2027 update describes E-utilities and Datasets access, while the CDD update covers domain and family models, curation, precomputed annotations and search services. RGD adds new rat reference and strain assemblies, variant data for 118 strains, reprocessed GEO RNA-Seq and new disease portals. The IGVF Data Portal preprint offers a public repository and API with knowledge-graph-integrated results and agentic-tool support. The items differ in scope; the new content lies in expanded coverage and access layers, not a shared method.
